svg.text: Hybrid DNS Architecture: Private Resolver, Rulesets & NxDomainRedirect
Resolves Hub-linked Private Zones + public recursion
Longest suffix wins; up to 5 in / 5 out EPs per resolver
Loop Guardrail: Never Link Inbound Rulesets to Hub VNet!
If a ruleset forwards privatelink.* or azure.contoso.com to 10.64.1.68
and links to vnet-hub-westeurope, Inbound EP queries loop back to
10.64.1.68 until SERVFAIL. Link Private Zones directly instead.
Zero hairpinning for internet & local zones;
AKS uses NodeLocal DNSCache to save QPS.
Always beats ruleset rules for same domain!
3. Public Internet Recursion via Azure DNS
DNS Query / Conditional Forwarding Path (UDP & TCP 53)
